title: CS 4535: Checkpoint 1
description: Due Tue Oct 13, 23:59 ET. Judgment returned by Mon Oct 19.
completedHtml:
Checkpoint 1 submitted.

Your team's review and your individual feedback come back by Mon Oct 19. Standup #2 is in the room on Wed Oct 14.

elements.name: intro
elements.html: About 15 minutes if your work is committed. Link things rather than describing them. We read this alongside your team's review and send back a written judgment by Mon Oct 19: on track or not, and why. See Project Milestones & Checkpoints.

elements.name: sprint_artifact
elements.title: Link to your async sprint artifact in notes/

validators.text: Paste a full link to the file in your team repo.

elements.name: sprint_use
elements.title: In one sentence: what can a teammate do with it?

elements.name: reviews
elements.title: Links to the code reviews you've written so far
elements.description: One per line. Mark any that were outside your team. Pass needs six across the term, at least two outside your team.

elements.name: study_timing
elements.title: When does your team's user study run?

choices.text: Early: as a sprint objective or right after it
Mid-project, on a prototype (Oct 14 to Nov 5)
Late, on what we shipped (before Nov 18)

elements.name: study_role
elements.title: What's your part in it?
elements.description: Planning, recruiting, running sessions, or analysis. One or two sentences.

elements.name: band
elements.title: Which band are you working toward?
elements.description: If this is different from your declaration, resubmit the band declaration too.

elements.name: distinction_options
elements.title: Which Distinction requirements are you aiming for?

choices.text: A feature owned end to end, through deployed and monitored
A design decision documented and defended in review
Work delivered through your cross-project function
Evidence about users, gathered and then acted on
A code review checklist entry you proposed

validators.text: Distinction needs four of the five.
